scenarios.title: New enrollment or future eligibility uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date
gaps: Semantic duplicate: Test Case Id 'TC_002' shares the same business intent as 'TC_001' — both validate that for a member whose eligibility span has not yet begun, the transaction effective date loaded in Facets is the Eligibility Date through the same end-to-end flow. Evidence from TC_001 Test Case Name: 'Verify AR PASSE new enrollment with future Eligibility Date uses the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date when Assessment Date is earlier'; evidence from TC_002 Test Case Name: 'Verify AR PASSE future eligibility transaction with no other business changes still uses the Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date'

scenarios.title: Maintenance Date is not used outside the explicitly allowed current-eligibility relevant-field rule
gaps: Coverage gap for TC_003: scenario description field says "Conditions to cover: 1) New enrollment or future eligibility does not use Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date. 2) Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed does not use Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date. 3) Future eligibility with Assessment Date unchanged and a qualifying field change does not use Maintenance Date as the transaction effective date.", and domain hint says "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)." TC_003 also requires "MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)"; add a dedicated test case for it
